card.name: ID in NSAID, plus scattered words
card.fires_on: Mainly the final piece "ID" completing the drug class name NSAID in the phrase "short-term NSAID therapy". Weaker, scattered hits on words like "hormone" in antidiuretic hormone, "with" after postmarketing experience, and "pre" before "- and post-marketing".

modes.label: End of NSAID
modes.description: The closing "ID" of NSAID right before the word therapy.
modes.example: However, even short-term NSA<<ID>> therapy is not without risk.

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: Single words in adverse-reaction text, such as "hormone" in a syndrome name or "with" after postmarketing experience.
modes.example: Can occur in association with syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic<< hormone>> secretion (SIADH)

card.plain: It mostly lights up on the last letters of the drug class name NSAID in a repeated risk warning.
